summary: The new county-correlates script is internally coherent, but it is not connected to the claim registry: the paper’s county-level claim remains forcibly UNCHECKED even after the script runs. The review driver also still exits early when a working tree contains only untracked files, despite newly instructing reviewers to include them.

findings.title: The new producing script cannot verify the county-correlates claim because the registry still marks it as having no code
findings.what_the_code_does: The new script computes county-level means, splits counties using ``v' > `med'` versus ``v' <= `med'`, and exports `countyIncongAbove*` and `countyIncongBelow*`. But the corresponding registry entry still says `status = "nocode"`, `values = [""]`, and `script = "none for all states"`; `check_claims.py` then unconditionally assigns every `nocode` claim the result `UNCHECKED`.
findings.why_it_matters: The draft claims that incongruence is notably higher in all three above-median county groups, but neither the direction nor magnitude is checked against the newly exported results. The committed report confirms that the claim remains UNCHECKED and does not read `compute_county_correlates.tex`, so adding the script to the runner has not established the paper claim.
findings.how_to_check: Run `rg -n "county-correlates|compute_county_correlates" replication/claims.toml replication/claims_report.md`, then run the machine-A pipeline and claim checker. The county claim will remain UNCHECKED regardless of the generated result file while its status is `nocode`.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the registry entry to `status = "scripted"` with `script = "CODE/compute_county_correlates.do"`, and add an assertion requiring each exported above-median rate to exceed its corresponding at-or-below rate. Run machine A and regenerate `claims_report.md`, committing the generated result file if results are part of the replication archive.

findings.title: Working-tree reviews still exit without reviewing when all changes are untracked
findings.what_the_code_does: The prompt now tells the reviewer to inspect `git status --short` for `??` files, but the preflight still sets `$diffStat` only from `git ... diff HEAD --stat`. Git diff does not include untracked files, so an untracked-only tree makes `$diffStat` blank and triggers `exit 0` with “No uncommitted changes.”
findings.why_it_matters: A newly created analysis or replication file can be omitted from review entirely—the exact failure the prompt change is intended to prevent. This can allow number-changing code to reach submission without an independent review.
findings.how_to_check: In a throwaway Git repository with a clean commit, create one untracked file and compare `git diff HEAD --stat` with `git status --short`; the former is empty while the latter shows `??`. Running this review driver with `-Target working` will exit at line 204.
findings.suggested_fix: Include `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` or parsed `git status --porcelain` in the emptiness test, and exit only when both the tracked diff and untracked-file list are empty.

verified_clean.item: The county analysis uses one observation per county and county-unweighted comparisons, matching the unit stated in the draft.
verified_clean.evidence: The script collapses by `state_folder_name county_folder_name` and then summarizes across county rows at CODE/compute_county_correlates.do:36-49; the draft explicitly frames the result at county level at D:/repos/6638fa0fd89fbec05130caeb/DHTS-2026-10-12.tex:749.

verified_clean.item: The new Stata comparisons guard the relevant missing-value traps.
verified_clean.evidence: South is generated only when `bpl<.` at CODE/compute_county_correlates.do:31; education is defined only for valid codes at line 34; and the above-median condition explicitly includes ``v' < .` at line 44. Missing values do not satisfy the at-or-below condition at line 47.

verified_clean.item: The age comparison does not silently classify missing ages as under 30 in the produced analysis sample.
verified_clean.evidence: The upstream construction retains only `age>=10 & age<.` at CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:92-98, before saving the `temp.dta` read by the new script; the new definition is at CODE/compute_county_correlates.do:33.

verified_clean.item: The runner places the new county script after creation of its analysis input.
verified_clean.evidence: A full run invokes `create_figures_SSHA2025` first and then `compute_county_correlates`; a skip-rebuild run preflights the existing `temp.dta` at replication/run_machineA.do:50-52 and replication/run_machineA.do:80-90.

verified_clean.item: The paper describes the county outcome as transcription incongruence rather than accuracy or verified error.
verified_clean.evidence: The draft uses “incongruent transcription” at D:/repos/6638fa0fd89fbec05130caeb/DHTS-2026-10-12.tex:749, while the code computes its complement as `gen byte incong = 1-congruent` at CODE/compute_county_correlates.do:30.

verified_clean.item: The county claim is descriptive rather than causal, avoiding an identification claim unsupported by this code.
verified_clean.evidence: The draft says higher rates are “occurring” in specified counties at D:/repos/6638fa0fd89fbec05130caeb/DHTS-2026-10-12.tex:749; the script performs descriptive median splits and means only at CODE/compute_county_correlates.do:39-53.

verified_clean.item: The PowerShell change suppresses the known Git safe-CRLF stderr condition during its tracked-diff check.
verified_clean.evidence: The code temporarily changes `$ErrorActionPreference`, invokes Git with `core.safecrlf=false`, redirects stderr, and restores the prior setting at review/Run-Review.ps1:194-201.

review_limits: The external Stata data were not loaded and the Stata pipeline was not run, so the numerical direction and magnitude of the three county comparisons could not be established.
No `replication/results/compute_county_correlates.tex` exists in the reviewed tree, and the current claims report does not list it among result files read.

The review could verify source-level Stata logic but not data-dependent properties such as missing county identifiers, county coverage, or whether ties at each county-share median create materially unbalanced groups.
The review was scoped to the uncommitted working-tree changes and their direct paper/code context, not a fresh audit of every pre-existing paper result.
